notes: Dia is free: all three looks (Classic, Widgets, Ring), with its own short editor: the three looks, Dark or Light, the base colour and a background picture or video.
Dia Light: black type on white, in every look. Dia's red now reads clearly on black and on white.
Dia on wide screens shows more: the time, discs for the clock and power, loads and a departure board.
Dia on a desktop or mini PC with no battery shows Uptime where the battery would be.
Kore, an AIDA64 example theme, is free: pick its font and colour from its presets. Your own AIDA64 themes import in the Themes tab, which every plan now sees.
